technique_name: What is the most efficient way to test a model built by a GPT language model?
description: The most efficient way to test a model built by a GPT language model is to use automated Natural Language Testing (NLT). NLT is an efficient method for testing a language model's ability to generate valid text with different properties and distributions, while also testing its robustness against perturbation.
